pilots.name: Gnumeric Bypass Pilot — Designed Exception Verification
pilots.purpose: Confirm Gnumeric bypass is architecturally correct (not a security hole), document exception path

steps.expected: Gnumeric task entries in hard-coded catalog
steps.notes: This is the bypass — hard-coded tasks bypass P-level check entirely

steps.description: Verify V13 PASSES for Gnumeric with exception_classification

steps.result: DESIGNED — Gnumeric has no formal spec; P1 ceiling is correct; schema_authority_available exception is architecturally correct. The bypass is documented and intentional.
steps.concern: The bypass path in product_task_selector does NOT call authority_gate_validation.py — this means the P1 classification is never actually verified at task selection time. The exception_classification in evidence is asserted by the worker, not derived from authority_gate_validation. This is the structural gap to close in Phase A-004.

pilots.notes: Gnumeric exception is correct by design. But the exception is asserted by workers, not enforced by authority_gate_validation.py at task selection time. Phase A-004 closes this gap.
